{{# Date fieldtype (App\Fieldtypes\Date, extends Statamic\Fieldtypes\Date). Single mode (`mode: single`, the default): Renders a native via the default partial. Assumes the blueprint sets `format: 'Y-m-d'` (or omits time) so `value` arrives as a date-only string. When `time_enabled: true` or a custom `format` is in use the stored string contains time components that HTML5 date inputs will reject; blueprints that need time should use a separate time field or switch to `text` with a custom pattern. Range mode (`mode: range`): Renders two date inputs side-by-side as `name="{handle}[start]"` and `name="{handle}[end]"`, which is the shape `Date::process()` (inherited from core, vendor/statamic/cms/src/Fieldtypes/Date.php:234) expects. Static earliest/latest bounds: `earliest_date_type: custom` with `earliest_date_custom: 'Y-m-d'` and the equivalent for `latest_date_*` render as `min`/`max` on both modes. `earliest_date_type: today` and the field-relative / offset-based boundary types are out of scope here — they're dynamic and belong with the calculation-engine surface tracked in UAMS-Web/uams-statamic-archive#672. #}} {{# Resolve effective min/max from Date-specific config, falling back to plain `min`/`max` keys if the blueprint author set those instead.
